runtime.name: omp
runtime.configuration: Generated routing, PR, and writing Skills in a disposable two-commit repository; root-only read run; runner stdout and stderr incorrectly placed inside the repository.
runtime.permissionProfile: read-only workflow contract with inspection commands

assertions.evidence: All Skill reads came from the fixture.
The explicit ready-PR request selected opening-a-pr.
technical-writing and unslop were loaded in order.
The root resolved example/oms-pr-fixture, main, and feature/normalize-greeting.
The root inspected the one-commit range and two changed paths.
The root ran the greeting test and captured two passes.
The single feature commit followed the baseline.
A conventional title and all required body sections were returned.
The unknown scm.pull_requests packet selected the briefing fallback.
An exact gh pr create command using --body-file was returned but not run.
No network or forge command ran.
The result explicitly said no PR URL exists.
The harness created untracked final.txt and stderr.log inside the repository, so strict git status was not clean even though workflow files and commits were unchanged.

limitations: The hardened rerun places runner logs outside the repository and requires a completely clean git status.
